items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Bobby and McCoy Tyner — they seem to be two of the greatest improvisers that I can— You know if I think of pure improvising?

ctx.x: Yeah. But those are the kind of people that you feel better after you hang out with them. © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-

I know it. I know it. Oh boy. Bobby Hutcherson is another one. Bobby and McCoy Tyner — they seem to be two of the greatest improvisers that I can— You know if I think of pure improvising? And I’d have to add Herbie Hancock into that too. That they can just take, you know just bend harmony or whatever they do, everything is so pliable in their hands.
I think I have a piece here that you played on.
